key: F1 to F8 (or Alt+F1 to Alt+F8)
effect: Choose merc 1 to 8. The merc must be alive and on the map.

key: Left click on a merc face (portrait columns)
effect: Chooses that merc, the same as its key F1 to F8.
Walk cursor. The first click marks the tile and shows the path and AP cost. With Safety Move on, a second click on the same tile starts the walk.
Chooses that merc. If the click fails, the status line shows "Not available!".

key: Alt + left click on the selected merc
effect: Changes the posture of the selected merc at once, with no confirm click.

key: Left click with the door or hand cursor
effect: The merc uses the door or object on the tile. For some objects the hand cursor needs a second click on the same tile.
Switches the cursor between the walk cursor and the weapon cursor, if the merc holds an item in the main hand.

key: Shift + left click on a tile
effect: The merc sneaks to the tile. The step AP cost can differ from a normal walk.

key: Right click on the selected merc
effect: Asks to change the posture. Left click on the same tile to confirm, Escape to cancel.
The selected merc turns toward the mouse tile. A fight turn costs 1 AP.

key: Hold right button, move the mouse down, release
effect: Look mode. The game shows the overview of the whole sector map.

key: Right click on a sign, or with the hand cursor
effect: Zooms the ground item or shows the sign text. Any key or click ends it.

key: Right click on a merc portrait
effect: Opens the switch view of that merc: max aim, rsv pts (stop at low AP) and mute. Left click a switch to flip it. Right click closes the view.

key: Hold left button on a merc bar area
effect: Shows the stat numbers of that merc while you hold the button.
source: panel.md "Stat popup (left button held on a bar area)"

key: Left drag from the map toward an edge
effect: Leaves the sector over that edge if the squad can. An arrow shows while you hold the button. A "?" cursor means you cannot leave there.
ALL-move. The whole squad walks to the mouse tile. Not available in a fight.

key: Rest the mouse on a tile
effect: The status line shows the AP cost and, with Show Paths on, path marks show.

key: Click on a button of the top strip (DONE, TRAV, INV, MAP, OPT, ABORT)
effect: Does the same as the key D, T, I, M, F10 or A. DONE works only in a fight on your turn.
source: panel.md "Clicks on the top strip (button faces)"

key: Click on the sector box of the top strip
effect: Pauses the game, like the key P.

key: Left click on a bottom strip box
effect: Takes the item from the box, or puts the cursor item into it. Ctrl takes one item from a stack.
source: panel.md "Clicks on the bottom strip (item boxes)"

key: Right click on a bottom strip box
effect: First box: the gun goes to a free box. Last box: swaps the two hands. Other boxes: opens the inventory screen.
source: panel.md "Clicks on the bottom strip (item boxes)"

effect: Stops the selected merc on the next tile. Also cancels an open aim or walk confirm. It never quits the game.
Move the map view one tile. A second press within 70 ms waits; with the Fast Scroll switch there is no wait.
Move the map view one tile in that direction after 200 ms, then one tile every 70 ms while the mouse stays at the edge.
Time compression on or off, outside a fight. In a fight the status line shows "Can't compress time, there are enemies nearby!".

key: Any key or mouse click during time compression
effect: Turns time compression off. The key or click does nothing else.
Opens the inventory screen of the selected merc. The merc needs at least 15 hit points.
Opens the guard screen (island map with the guard panel).
Traverse popup. Pick NORTH, WEST, EAST or SOUTH (keys N, W, E, S; Escape cancels). The squad must stand together at that map edge.
Asks "ABORT this day?". Yes asks "RESTART this day?". Yes restarts the day, No goes back to the office.
Shows the stat numbers of all mercs at once. Any key or click ends it.
source: panel.md "Stat popup (left button held on a bar area)"

effect: Shows the text of the last quote again. No voice plays.
Selects the next merc (wraps from the last to the first). In a fight it shows the path of its open walk order. Not with an item on the cursor.
In a fight: the view goes to the next enemy in sight (the next one each press). With none in sight it shows "No enemies visible!".
The selected merc swaps places with the merc or guard under the mouse, next to it. Both pay the step AP. Too far, too weak or too few AP shows a message.
Music volume up or down by 1 (0 to 100, start 100). The first press sets the volume, so the music can get quieter even with +.
Sound volume up or down by 1 (0 to 100, start 70). The first press sets the volume, so the sounds get quieter even with "." .
Shows the version text "Release  v1.13b  Sep 07-95" in the message box.
Pause. A wristwatch with the time shows at the map corner. Any key or click ends the pause.
Zooms the item or sign on the tile under the mouse. Any key or click ends it.
Shows or hides the line "how many enemies each merc sees".
Opens the Control Panel with the 16 switches.
Next view mode: normal, wide map, full-screen map, overview.
source: panel.md "View modes (keys PgUp, PgDn, Insert, Tab)"

effect: Previous view mode.
source: panel.md "View modes (keys PgUp, PgDn, Insert, Tab)"

effect: Overview of the whole sector map.
source: panel.md "View modes (keys PgUp, PgDn, Insert, Tab)"

effect: Switches between the normal screen and the last wide view. In the overview it switches the merc filter.
source: panel.md "View modes (keys PgUp, PgDn, Insert, Tab)"

effect: Walks the selected merc there, or selects a merc. Right click jumps to that place in the normal view.
source: panel.md "View modes (keys PgUp, PgDn, Insert, Tab)"

effect: Quick Save, then Y to confirm. Not in a fight.
source: savegame.md "Quick Save and Quick Restore: the steps"

effect: Quick Restore, then Y to confirm. Needs a quick save file.
source: savegame.md "Quick Save and Quick Restore: the steps"

effect: Asks "Exit to DOS?". Yes asks "Save day in progress?" (yes saves the quick save), then the game ends with a farewell line.
Ends your turn.

key: Left click on an enemy with the weapon cursor
effect: Starts the aim. The AP number shows. Left click again fires. With Fast Firing on, the first click fires.
Adds one more aim step (up to 4 extra AP). After the maximum it goes back to the lowest aim.
Cancels the shot.
Shows "ALL-MOVE not available during Turn-based". The squad does not move.
Shows "Can't compress time, there are enemies nearby!".
Picks the item up, or puts the cursor item down in that place. Shift swaps the cursor item and the place item.

key: Ctrl + left click on a stack
effect: Takes one item from a stack of two or more.
Shows the item info box and plays the item name.
The merc drinks the item on the cursor. Costs 5 AP.
The merc uses a camouflage kit. Costs 10 AP.

key: Left click on a merc slot at the screen side
effect: Shows that merc.
Turns the Subtitles option on or off and shows "Text ".
Closes the inventory screen. With an item on the cursor it shows "Better put that down first!".
Turns the switch ON or OFF. Sound FX and Subtitles cannot both be off.
Closes the panel and goes back to the game.

key: Left click on Quick Save or Quick Restore
effect: Closes the panel and does the quick save or restore. Quick Save shows only when allowed; Quick Restore only with a quick save file.
Closes the panel.

key: Right click on a sector you own
effect: Takes one guard into the hand. "Awaiting dest" counts the guards in the hand.

key: Left click on a linked sector
effect: Sends the guard in the hand there. The travel hours show while the mouse rests on a sector.

key: Left click on the sector the guard came from
effect: Puts the guard back.

key: Ctrl + right click on a sector
effect: Calls the last guard sent to that sector back home.
Leaves the screen and the guards set off. With guards still in the hand it shows "There are Guards without destinations!".
Depends on the tab. Team tab: sets the starting sector for the team. Tappers tab: adds 3 tappers. Guards tab: adds a guard.
source: strategic.md "Sector click on the island map"

effect: Depends on the tab. Team tab: clears the starting sector. Tappers tab: removes 3 tappers. Guards tab: removes a guard.
source: strategic.md "Sector click on the island map"

effect: Subtitles switch on or off, with the message "Text on" or "Text off". The guard screen does the same.
Starts the day after the checks. A box asks for the answer (Y, O or Enter = yes; N or Escape = no).

key: Click on the start (OK) button (bottom right)
effect: Starts the day, like Enter.
source: strategic.md "Sector click on the island map"

key: Click on the field box at the bottom left
effect: Opens the assignment screen.
source: strategic.md "Opening and leaving the assignment screen"

effect: Shows the text of the last quote again.
Asks "Exit to DOS?". Yes ends the game with a farewell line. With no quick save, the saves of the current day are deleted.
Shows the items of that merc.

key: Left click on an item, then on a free place
effect: The item sticks to the mouse, then goes into the place.
source: strategic.md "Item moves on the item panel"

effect: Shows the item info box. Any click closes it.
source: strategic.md "Right button on the item panel"

key: Click on the duty name above a face
effect: Opens the duty menu. FIRE asks "Fire <name>?" with Y or N.
Puts all items of the selected merc into the item store.
source: strategic.md "Key E: all items into the store"

effect: Shows the text of the last quote again.
Leaves the screen. With nobody on duty a question asks to confirm.
source: strategic.md "Opening and leaving the assignment screen"

effect: Asks "Exit to DOS?". Yes ends the game with a farewell line. With no quick save, the saves of the current day are deleted.
Sleep. With no team the box says "You try to sleep, but ...".

key: Click on the top half of the calendar
effect: Save Game: click a slot row, type a name, Enter saves. Right click or Escape cancels.
source: strategic.md "Save Game and Restore Game (the slot list)"

key: Click on the bottom half of the calendar
effect: Restore Game: click a row to load that game.
source: strategic.md "Save Game and Restore Game (the slot list)"

key: Click on the papers on the desk
effect: View Team: the team ledger. Any click, Enter, Escape or Space closes it.
Opens the A.I.M. screen. It works only when the A.I.M. link is on for the day.
Leave: back to the main menu.

key: Click on the box on the wall
effect: Opens the Control Panel switch box. Click a lever to flip a switch.
Shows the message box "Release  v1.13b  Sep 07-95" (the text of JA.EXE).
Ends the game at once (no question, no save).
Shows the text of the last quote again over the page.
Shows the previous merc.
Shows the next merc.
Shows the next merc. Hold the button to repeat.
Starts the interview and the hire.
INFO opens the statistics page. GEAR and BIO switch the text panel between gear and biography.
Leaves the screen. Pending hires are paid with the helicopter charge.
Shows the version message.
Shows the text of the last quote again.
Turns the Subtitles option on or off and shows "Text  on" or "Text  off".
Asks "Exit to DOS?". Yes ends the game with a farewell line. With no quick save, the saves of the current day are deleted.

key: Click on a face (Not enough funds)
effect: Asks "Don't pay <name>?". Y sends the merc away unpaid.

key: Click on a face (after OK on the day replay)
effect: Asks "Fire <name>?". Y fires the merc; the team closes up. The mouse on a face shows the "fire" tooltip.

key: L, T, Alt+X (day replay and payroll screens)
effect: L repeats the last quote, T switches the subtitles, Alt+X asks "Exit to DOS?".
Moves the lit row. The mouse jumps to the row.
Picks the lit row: Start New Game, Continue Game, or Exit.
Picks that row.

key: Up, Down, Enter on the difficulty and quick-save screens
effect: Moves the lit row and picks it. The choice cannot change later.

key: Y or N at "Continue last day in progress?"
effect: Y continues from the quick save. N asks again; Y deletes the quick save and day files.
Answers yes.
Answers no.
Closes the message box.
Stops the replay animation and skips the rest of the replay.
Stops the film, the intro or the credits.

key: Ctrl+B, Ctrl+A, Ctrl+L, Ctrl+D (in this order)
effect: Turns debug level 4 on. A wrong key in the chain sets the level to 0. Ctrl+D at level 4 turns it off. Nothing shows.
Gives every merc full clips.
Heals the selected merc fully.
Kills the soldier on the tile under the mouse.
Breaks the object (door) on the tile under the mouse.
Teleports the selected merc to the tile under the mouse.
Turns Alt+S quick save in a fight on or off.
Shows or hides roofs.
Shows or hides all enemies.
Show tile numbers (overlay, struc, gridno) of the tile under the mouse in message boxes.
Centers the view on the selected merc and shows four pages of soldier data.
Shows the opponent lists of the soldier under the mouse in message boxes.

key: Shift + left click on a soldier
effect: Opens the inventory screen of that soldier (also an enemy), then the four data pages.
Counts the rest of the stats without the pauses and the clicks.
